entities.name: Abd al-Qadir al-Maraghi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abd al-Qadir al-Maraghi ibn Ghaybi was a music theorist, composer and performer of the Timurid Empire. A renowned writer on music and musician, his theories had a profound influence on subsequent Persian, Arab, and Turkish music.
